in_greek.name: Hoppe
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Hope in God
in_greek.long_meaning: Hoppe είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the German word 'hoffen', which means 'to hope'. The name Hoppe signifies the deep-rooted belief and trust in God.

in_latin.name: Hoppe
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Hope in God
in_latin.long_meaning: Hoppe est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the German word 'hoffen', which means 'to hope'. The name Hoppe signifies the deep-rooted belief and trust in God.
